name: Erudite Predator Style (Combat, Style)
body:
Each mistake is a way to end a fight.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Bluff 1 Rank, Improved Unarmed Strike

Benefits: While using this style, you gain a +1 bonus to AC against each opponent who misses you with an attack until the start of your next turn. For each attack an opponent misses you with, you gain a +1 bonus on damage rolls with unarmed strikes against that opponent the following round.

Special: This style’s benefit applies to finessable weapons, light weapons, and natural weapons.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
